title: Saudi Arabia says 2 airports hit in renewed fighting with Yemen's Houthis
description:
Saudi Arabia said three people were injured in the latest attacks on its airports since fighting with Yemen's Houthi rebels reignited. Meanwhile, Palestinian health officials said an Israeli airstrike in Gaza City killed one person.
Nearly three years after Hamas' October 7, 2023 attack on Israel, conflict in the Middle East has persisted almost without interruption, spreading across the region, including to Iran, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen.
Here is the latest news from the Middle East on Monday. Full coverage is available here.
Saudis says 2 airports were hit as fighting grinds on with Houthis
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Saudi Arabia on Tuesday acknowledged that two of its airports were attacked, leaving three lightly injured, hours after the Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels said they fired missiles and drones at the kingdom.
The attacks were the latest in the conflict between the kingdom and the Houthis in neighbouring Yemen.
